resources.string: Choose what the customer brings back and how much. It counts in TODAY\'s close as \"Returns\" (the sale\'s day does not change) and the stock goes back to inventory.
That is more than what is left to return.
Return saved: %1$s. The owner is notified.
You can undo your last sale during the first 5 minutes. It is recorded as voided, with your name and the reason, and the owner is notified. After 5 minutes only the owner or an admin can delete it.
The 5 minutes have passed (or it is no longer your last sale). Ask the owner or an admin to delete it.

What was refunded today, or voided today from earlier days, is already in today\'s expected cash: earlier days do not change.
%1$s has not synced since %2$s: it may have sales that have not arrived yet.
The browser could not be opened.
The console lives in the web panel. You can go to the console or create a business to use the register.
The country suggests the currency and time zone; you can change them now.
The currency cannot change after the first sale.
There are sales recorded in %1$s: changing the currency would change the value of everything before, so it is fixed.
The currency and country can change while there are no sales. After that they are fixed.
Your Cuentiva account is deleted: your name, email and photo are removed, all your sessions are closed and you no longer belong to the businesses where you worked. This cannot be undone.
You own %1$s. To delete your account, that business must be deleted first (Business settings › \"Delete business\"; it is permanently erased after 30 days) or handed over to someone else.

The business owner created your user: you do not have an account of your own to delete. Ask the owner or an admin to deactivate you in More › Team. You will no longer be able to sign in; the sales you recorded stay in the business\'s books.
You need a connection to delete your account.
A cashier undid their last sale

%1$s operations by %2$s (%3$s) arrived after they were deactivated. They were accepted because they were made before, offline; review them in Sales.
The currency can no longer change: there are sales recorded in it.
